notes: All faction buildings belong to 'The Kingdom' faction (the only faction in the MVP).
Town Hall, Stronghold and Citadel are the same building at tiers 1, 2 and 3 (upgradesTo).
'requires' uses building ids. 'stronghold' means a Town Hall at tier 2 or higher, 'citadel' means tier 3.
footprint is [width, depth] in game units, snapped to a 1-unit build grid.
bounty is gold for the enemy hero who lands the last hit. Buildings give no XP.

buildings.name: Town Hall
buildings.look: Big timber and stone hall with a tall roof and a bell tower. Team color: roof flags and banners over the door.

buildings.name: Stronghold
buildings.look: Town Hall with stone walls, a second floor and two small towers.

buildings.name: Citadel
buildings.look: Small castle with a central tower, golden roof tips and big banners.

buildings.name: House
buildings.look: Small cottage with a thatched roof and a chimney. Team color: door and window shutters.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.look: Long wooden hall with crossed swords over the door and a training dummy. Team color: banners.

buildings.name: Archery Range
buildings.look: Open wooden shed with straw targets and a fence. Team color: awning cloth.

buildings.name: Forge
buildings.notes: Needed before the hero can buy weapon and armor upgrades at the Town Hall.
buildings.look: Stone smithy with a big chimney, glowing furnace and an anvil outside. Team color: roof cloth.

buildings.name: Chapel
buildings.look: White stone chapel with a round window and a small bell. Team color: stained glass and banner.

buildings.name: Workshop
buildings.look: Wooden workshop with a crane, gears and logs. Team color: roof cloth.

buildings.name: Hawk Roost
buildings.look: Tall stone tower with a big nest of branches on top. Team color: flags around the nest.

buildings.name: Watchtower
buildings.look: Thin wooden tower on a stone base with a roofed top. Team color: flag on top.

buildings.name: Hero Shrine
buildings.notes: Summons the faction's own hero (one per faction, chosen by the AI). The hero comes back to life here, with the same wait as player heroes.
buildings.look: Round stone platform with four pillars and a glowing crystal in the middle. Team color: banners on the pillars.

neutralBuildings.name: Gold Mine
neutralBuildings.look: Cave in a rock with wooden beams and glittering gold.

neutralBuildings.name: Trader's Tent
neutralBuildings.look: Colorful tent with crates, a scale and a short bearded merchant.

neutralBuildings.name: Temple Market
neutralBuildings.look: Old stone altar with lanterns and a hooded trader.

neutralBuildings.name: Fountain of Life
neutralBuildings.look: Round stone fountain with glowing blue-green water.
